meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新版本发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布了新版本后需要确认它真正上线了
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version to npm and confirm the release succeeded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a new version and verify it went live

howto.what: 安装了此技能后,当你要求发布时,Claude 会按完整流程执行:触发 GitHub Actions 的 publish 工作流,期间持续监控进度,然后核对 GitHub Release、npm 包版本和 Discord 公告,最后汇报结果。它不会进行代码审查或修复。
howto.when: 当你明确要求发布/部署,说出 “publish”“release” 等触发词,并同时给出发布级别(patch、minor、major 或具体版本号)时触发。若未给出级别,Claude 会先停下询问。

say.text: 帮我发布一个 patch 版本
执行 minor 发布,新版本 1.2.0

say.note: 按显式语义版本号执行发布。

howto.what_en: After installing, when you ask to publish, Claude runs the full release workflow: triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, monitors it, then verifies the GitHub Release, npm versions, and Discord announcement, and reports back. It does not run code review or fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to publish or deploy using trigger words like "publish" or "release", and provide a release selector (patch, minor, major, or an explicit semver). Without one, it stops and asks.

say_en.note: Claude runs the publish workflow end to end.

say_en.text: Do a minor release to version 1.2.0.
say_en.note: Publishes at that version and verifies npm and GitHub.
